trust_decision.summary: Whether a server-supplied GitLab `Link: rel=next` pagination URL may be followed with the same authenticated request options; the fix decides it in GitlabHttp.requestJsonUnsafe by requiring next-URL origin == request origin.

landing_point.why: Only place in the GitLab code that parses a Link header and follows `next`. The sibling GitHub fix (lib/util/http/github.ts:443) sets the same pattern in the pinned history.

fix_sites.entry_point: GitlabHttp get/getJson*(…, {paginate:true}) used by platform/gitlab, gitlab-tags/releases/packages datasources, gitlab presets, gitlab changelog

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Bitbucket Cloud's paginator follows a JSON-body `next` field rather than a `Link` header. The repo's own lint rule also says platform-driven pagination may cross origins (tools/lint/rules/no-unvalidated-pagination-url.js:56), so a solver can call Bitbucket 'a different mechanism, a different platform'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With GITLAB_IGNORE_REPO_URL set, the next URL's protocol and host are rewritten to the configured baseUrl. Self-hosted instances whose Link headers carry an internal host must keep paginating. Same-origin multi-page results must still be concatenated.

O6_input_shapes: absolute next URL with a different host
absolute next URL with a different scheme or port (origin compare)
next URL rewritten by GITLAB_IGNORE_REPO_URL before the check

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Bitbucket Cloud paginator follows a server-supplied body `next` URL with the same authenticated options and no origin check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a Link header and not GitLab. The lint rule exempts platform pagination (tools/lint/rules/no-unvalidated-pagination-url.js:56,70-76).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a variant that follows the full next URL instead of keeping only `uri.search`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gitea and Forgejo PR caches already parse the Link header next URL. Following it whole is the natural simplification (the forgejo copy is at lib/modules/platform/forgejo/pr-cache.ts:186).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Link-header based paginator in place of the page-counter loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gitea returns Link headers like GitLab does, so a maintainer could copy GitlabHttp's pagination code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: following a server-provided absolute next link instead of setting `start`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Bitbucket Cloud's sister client already follows body `next` URLs (lib/util/http/bitbucket.ts:62).

O9_family: CWE-601 open redirect / cross-origin pagination following that leaks credentials (SSRF-adjacent)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the github.ts origin compare into gitlab.ts:63 and stop, leaving the Bitbucket body-next paginator open.

out_of_scope_notes: Generic got redirect following (followRedirect) across hosts with auth was not examined.
findMatchingRule falls back across host types (lib/util/http/host-rules.ts:99-172); not pursued.
unverified: Fix commits 9d74afe9 (poetry manager, 2019) and 1af60f51 (Dockerfile AS names, 2017) in fix.diff are unrelated to this advisory and look mislabeled. Only a160e39c is the real fix (fix.diff:1-65).
Whether a cross-origin follow actually carries the token depends on how hostRules match (a rule with no matchHost, or an explicit httpOptions.token). Not traced per caller for GitLab or Bitbucket.
Recall: sibling fixes for github/nuget/docker and a lint rule naming the exact pattern sit in the pinned history (git log HEAD~4..HEAD), which points a solver straight at the GitLab analogue.
present_in_latest unknown: no latest release supplied.
